title: EDHaulAssist haul plan
description: A hauling plan imported by the EDHaulAssist EDMC plugin: a list of Runs, each a list of Stops at which commodities are bought. The Sell Location is not part of the file; it is configured in the plugin. Properties not listed here are ignored by the plugin.

schema.description: Format version. The plugin reads version 1 only.

name.description: A label for the plan, shown in the EDMC window.

runs.description: The round trips, flown in the order listed. Each ends with a delivery at the Sell Location.

run.description: One round trip: every Stop, then the Sell Location.

stops.description: The stations to buy at. Guidance follows the order listed, but they may be visited in any order.

stop.description: A station at which one or more commodities are bought.

system.description: The star system, spelled exactly as the galaxy map spells it. This is the text copied to the clipboard.

station.description: The station name as the game shows it. Matched against the journal ignoring case.

commodities.description: What to buy here. A commodity listed more than once at the same Stop is treated as one purchase of the combined quantity.

name.description: The in-game name ('Land Enrichment Systems') or the journal symbol ('terrainenrichmentsystems'). Case, spaces and punctuation do not matter. An unrecognised name loads with a warning.
